calls.summary: The team discussed the need for standardization of UI components such as badges, tags, and tokens to eliminate inconsistencies. Badges were defined as fixed status indicators, tags as user-defined entries, and tokens as dismissible in multi-select fields. The group emphasized a separate treatment for multi-select values to enhance user experience. Additionally, they agreed to use Radix as a base for badge components while allowing for customizations to maintain brand consistency. Naming conventions were simplified to avoid confusion. Concerns about color consistency, especially the overuse of purple in badges, were addressed, and clear rules for badge content were to be documented. The goal of these discussions was to streamline over 600 callouts and the application of UI elements while ensuring proper communication of design decisions across teams.
